title: Orphans
subtitle: Entries no longer present in the latest imported CSV. Delete them or relink translations onto a different entry.
empty: No orphaned records — imported CSVs match the current project.
noProject: Select a project to view orphans.

confirmDelete.title: Delete orphan?
confirmDelete.body: This permanently deletes the orphaned record and its translations. This cannot be undone.

relink.title: Relink orphan
relink.description: Move translations from this orphan onto another entry, ranked by how similar each candidate's source text is to this orphan's.
relink.confirmDescription: Choose how the orphan's translations are applied to the target entry before relinking.
relink.overrideEmptyOnly: Only fill empty translations (keep the target's existing ones)
relink.overrideAll: Override all translations with the orphan's
relink.aiRetranslateHint: After relinking, an AI pass compares the orphan's old source text with the target's new source text and updates each existing translation to reflect the same edit.
relink.aiNoModules: No AI-capable module is enabled — enable one in the global settings to use AI retranslation.

toast.aiRetranslateStarted: AI retranslate started — see the Activity tab
toast.aiRetranslateUnavailable: Relinked, but AI retranslate could not start (no AI-capable module available)
